# clify

Public JSON-over-curl API for AI agents. It exposes verified, read-only commands for public websites. No key, account, install, or browser is required for the hosted API.

## Machine-readable entry points
- Catalogue: https://clify-dev.netlify.app/sites.json
- Search by task or topic: https://clify-dev.netlify.app/search?q=what+you+need
- Site command schema: https://clify-dev.netlify.app/<site>.json
- Agent schema: https://clify-dev.netlify.app/agent.json
- Full guide: https://clify-dev.netlify.app/llms-full.txt
- Human-readable task guides: https://clify-dev.netlify.app/use-cases/

## Request pattern
GET https://clify-dev.netlify.app/<site>/<command>?<param>=<value>
Responses are one JSON object. Read commands are public and replay the site's own HTTP endpoints. Unknown sites return 404 with didYouMean and a request URL. Write commands return 405 and are never sent by the public API. Follow the command's params and exampleUrl in its JSON schema.

## Discovery
Use /search for a natural-language task, then open the returned site page or .json schema. For broad browsing, use /sites.json. Source: https://github.com/ToukoUrsin/clify. Hosted MCP: https://bold-cloud-h4u6s.run.mcp-use.com/mcp

- abc: abc.net.au — ABC News (Australian Broadcasting Corporation): search news, read top stories by state edition, browse topics, sections, authors and article metadata from abc.net.au/news.
